# Paris Unlocked

> > Expert travel guides, self-guided itineraries, and cultural insights for exploring Paris, Versailles, and France.

Paris Unlocked offers comprehensive travel planning resources including multi-day itineraries, neighborhood guides, museum recommendations, and deep dives into Parisian culture, history, and cuisine. The site specializes in helping independent travelers discover both iconic landmarks and hidden gems across Paris and surrounding regions.

## Key Topics

- Paris travel itineraries
- Versailles
- French Revolution history
- Paris museums (Musée d'Orsay, Louvre)
- Paris neighborhoods (Belleville, Latin Quarter, Montorgueil)
- Parisian cuisine and restaurants
- Revolutionary France and Reign of Terror
- Famous Parisians (Josephine Baker, Olympe de Gouges)
- Japanese restaurants in Paris
- Seasonal Paris (autumn activities)
- Paris culture and art
- Breton cuisine and cider
- Day trips from Paris (Reims, Chartres)
- Paris walking tours
- French food history
